GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 410.2 (21 Dec 45) ESS/IN
(SCAPIN - 474)
APO 500
21 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : The Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Steel Ship for Salvage and Tug Purposes, Request for Completing Construction of
1. Reference is made to letter CLO No. 847 (3.2) of 3 December 1945, requesting permission to complete construction at the Shimonoseki Shipyard of Mitsubishi Heavy Industries of a steel ship for salvage and tug purposes.
2. Permission is granted to complete the construction of the subject ship with the understanding that the material for construction is on hand as indicated in reference letter.
3. Approval of this headquarters will be obtained for the ultimate use of this vessel after construction has been completed.
4. An acknowledgement of this memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
